meta.title: The Tide Post
meta.story: Deliver invitations along the river and coast before the evening gathering. Collect the crystal postage, repair the shared route, and make sure even the farthest neighbor is included.

chapters.title: The Tide Post
chapters.story: Deliver invitations along the river and coast before the evening gathering. Collect the crystal postage, repair the shared route, and make sure even the farthest neighbor is included.

finale.title: Every Neighbor Invited
finale.story: The last invitation reaches the post office just as the first guests arrive. Boats, bridges, and lantern paths connect the whole route again. Your empty mailbag means that nobody has been forgotten.

levels.title: Invitation Morning
levels.story: The garden post office has a bundle of invitations and a pouch of crystal stamps. Gather the first stamps, pack your bag, and set out before the river tide turns. Either upper Super guide peg charges a longer aiming preview for your next shot toward the scattered crystal stamps.

levels.title: River Addresses
levels.story: The riverside mailboxes are marked with little suns. Light them to learn who lives along the water and discover where the old delivery route has been washed away. The upper Fireball pegs charge a next shot that burns down the mailbox rows, collecting nearby pegs along its route.

levels.title: Spray Bridge
levels.story: Mist has scattered crystal postage across the stepping stones. Gather what you can and carry the letters over the falls, watching the plate change between catching and bouncing. Either upper Magnet ball peg prepares your next shot to follow the moving plate through the mist.

levels.title: Bamboo Mailbox
levels.story: A playful breeze has tucked several invitations into a bamboo grove. Their crystal stamps shine between the stems; collect them so the letters can find their proper homes. The upper Echo ball pegs give your next shot another pass through the grove’s curling stems.

levels.title: The Forest Address Book
levels.story: Fallen twigs cover the keeper’s wooden address board. Clear the breakable pegs to read the names underneath and find a safe detour through the forest. Collect Blast ball at the diamond’s top, then direct your next shot into the crowded address board.

levels.title: The Lake Ferry
levels.story: The lake ferry is waiting for a new set of route markers. Gather the bright crystals, then leave one invitation with the crew who will keep this crossing open. The upper Multiball, Ghost ball and Super guide pegs prepare a spreading next shot through the ferry’s crystal rows.

levels.title: A Meadow Delivery
levels.story: A picnic in the meadow becomes your first cheerful delivery stop. Light the sun markers beside the blankets and your new friends will help mend the river route. Fireball on the left, Magnet ball near the center and Multiball on the upper right prepare your next meadow delivery for the timed plate.

levels.title: Blossom Square
levels.story: The square is full of petals and excited questions about the gathering. Collect the crystal stamps for the next bundle while neighbors sort your letters into neat piles. Magnet ball tops the left lane, Ghost ball the right, and Blast ball the central stamp rows, ready for your next shot.

levels.title: Harbor Signal
levels.story: At the harbor, the boats need a signal before they can leave together. Build a lively score to ring the dock bell and send the next delivery across the bay. Echo ball and Fireball top the harbor’s opposite loops; Magnet ball on the left shoulder helps your next shot return to the narrow plate.

levels.title: The Turning Tide
levels.story: The tide has covered the shortcut along the beach. Follow the floating crystals instead, and let the changing plate keep your ball moving while the water settles. Multiball waits at the valley’s center, with Magnet ball and Super guide on its shoulders to prepare your next crystal crossing.

levels.title: Letters at the Beacon
levels.story: The lighthouse keeper knows every boat on the coast. Light the sun markers around the beacon so its steady beam can guide your mail through the next stretch. Super guide crowns the beacon, while Ghost ball and Fireball on its upper slopes help your next shot reach the lower sun markers.

levels.title: Lagoon Post Route
levels.story: A string of floating post boxes crosses the quiet lagoon. Gather their crystal stamps and link the boxes into a route that the smaller boats can follow. Collect Echo ball and Multiball above the outer loops, or Ghost ball on the open central loop, for your next lagoon delivery.

levels.title: Palm Post
levels.story: The island’s post box waits under a friendly palm. Collect the postage for the island families, then leave invitations where the returning fishing crews will find them. Multiball, Fireball and Magnet ball along the upper palm route prepare your next shot to reach the island stamps and changing plate.

levels.title: Messages from the Reef
levels.story: Waterproof message capsules glow above the reef. Gather their crystals to learn which sea-watchers are coming and carry their replies safely back toward shore. Super guide, Ghost ball and Fireball across the upper reef row prepare your next shot through the capsules below.

levels.title: The Sand Courier
levels.story: A sand-road courier meets you with the final inland bundle. Clear the busy sign board so both delivery routes can share their directions and supplies. Echo ball, Blast ball and Magnet ball on the upper rim prepare a returning, clearing next shot across the busy sign board.

levels.title: Repair the Canyon Crossing
levels.story: Your new friends have brought rope for the broken crossing. Light the sun markers along the canyon bridge to guide the repair and reopen the route for everyone. Fireball and Ghost ball top opposite bridge columns; Super guide above the right span prepares a careful next shot toward the repair markers.

levels.title: Summit Post Station
levels.story: The most distant invitation belongs to a tiny station above the valley. Gather its crystal postage and leave a warm welcome for the family who watches the mountain weather. Magnet ball and Super guide top the summit, with Ghost ball on the upper right ridge to reach sheltered postage on your next shot.

levels.title: A Sky Full of Replies
levels.story: The mountain families send their replies beneath a bright aurora. Build a joyful chain of bounces to collect their signals before you begin the journey home. Magnet ball, Echo ball and Multiball across the upper aurora prepare a spreading return shot toward the narrow switching plate.

levels.title: Moonlit Mail Run
levels.story: Moonlight makes a silver path across the returning tide. Gather the last replies along that path; every crystal is another neighbor who plans to join the gathering. Ghost ball, Echo ball and Fireball across the upper silver path prepare your next shot to collect replies along the tide’s lower lanes.

levels.title: The Last Invitation
levels.story: The post office lantern is waiting at the end of the repaired route. Light the final sun markers and deliver your last invitation before the evening celebration begins. Multiball and Magnet ball wait on the crown’s shoulders, with Super guide at its peak, to prepare your final delivery shots.
